# Raw operation constructor and Meaning study

This informed study under #83/#46 preserves five complete first programs before
Raw changes, seven actual baseline observations and five later observations.
No external model was invoked and no blind authoring result is claimed.

The first tensor oracle used an unsupported classical statement body. Both parse
failures remain in attempt-01. Attempt-02 changes only those two complete
programs to supported parameter patterns and expression bodies; its two initial
Raw refusals are distinct from the original parse failures.

After implementation, unchanged sequence X;X, adjoint T and ordered left-X tensor
programs pass their independently declared exact finite Meaning requests. The
wrong-axis tensor and false child refinement below zero repetition reject at the
native contract check. Original refusals and raw output bytes remain unchanged.
The session lists every actual check; the authoring checker does not replay them.

Separate Rust tests compare complex results with independently written identity,
inverse-eighth-phase and ordered-axis expectations. Raw source replay tests also
reject native-valid gate/phase substitutions for all five constructors, and an
axis permutation in a differing-tree adjoint whose original caller retains a
separate owner. These are bounded checks, not an AST-to-step preservation proof,
a new constitutional guarantee or completion of the broader #83/#46 conditions.
Unsupported Raw primitives and rectangular Meaning equations remain open.
